paramList.default: Static eye-level wide shot. Sea wind catches Wei Xiaobao's hem, whipping it sharply left. His eyes dart rapidly while his lips press into a tight line. Directly behind him, Shuang'er's fingers tighten around the blade hilt. Su Quan's head pivots slightly, her cold gaze sweeping the dark treeline. Fang Yi, A Ke, Mu Jianping, and Zeng Rou shift their weight forward, grips firming on their weapons. Jianning Princess draws the swaddled infant closer, her lower lip trembling faintly. Torch flames lean heavily right, casting long, flickering shadows across the sand-stained ground. Cold moonlight glints off the restless water, interweaving with the warm firelight. A steady coastal wind sweeps through, carrying the sharp snap of burning pitch and the rhythmic crash of distant waves. Narration: "大海茫茫，波涛如怒。通吃岛上，一场死战即将来临。" - Spoken in a grave, resonant male voice with deliberate pacing. Cinematic wuxia aesthetic, photorealistic textures. All character appearance derives exclusively from the reference image.
